What the applicant claims, the ledger either confirms or denies, and the ledger never haggles. The stake comes back only after 13 days of clean grading, so a farm's 78905 POA is held hostage by its own conduct. Without a crystal the brick has no maker, without a ivory it has no weight, and without a beacon it has no firing — and a farm's brick is missing all three at once.
